short_description: Source-first URL intake for embed/source routing and local web reproduction handoff.
description: webEmbedding helps AI coding agents inspect public or user-authorized web pages before reproducing them. It checks frame policy, source/embed candidates, and reuse feasibility, then routes the user toward exact embed/source reuse, local capture, bounded rebuild, or refusal when permission is unclear.
review_boundary: The hosted app does not accept browser profiles, Playwright storage state, local output paths, screenshots, HAR files, capture bundles, or generated clone artifacts. Full capture and fidelity workflows remain local-only through npx -y web-embedding@latest mcp.
